[TASK: 2560x1440 2K QHD 16:9 ARCHITECTURAL RELIGHTING & STATIC RECONSTRUCTION]
Transform the reference photogrammetry plate into a razor-sharp, photorealistic 6x7 medium-format architectural survey photograph.

MANDATORY TRANSFORMATION RULES:
1. PLANAR RECTIFICATION & GEOMETRY LOCK: Treat the reference image as an immutable spatial coordinate frame. Eliminate all 3D mesh polygon wobble, melted facades, and distorted rooflines. Plumb all vertical walls to true gravity vertical. Render razor-sharp ashlar courses, straight timber sash mullions, and crisp slate roofs.
2. STATIC DECLUTTERING (MANDATORY): COMPLETELY ERASE all transient vehicles, parked cars, delivery vans, pedestrians, and temporary street clutter from the seed image. Repaint the carriageway with authentic road surfacing, stone setts, whinstone kerbs, and clean flagstone pavements.
3. BOTANICAL PHENOLOGY & CANOPY INTEGRITY: Overwrite all raw 3D mesh blob foliage with authentic seasonal canopy structures matching the target date. Zero green summer foliage during dormant/autumn/winter periods:
   * **Species Identification:** Central circus garden populated by mature *Acer pseudoplatanus* (Sycamore maple), *Tilia × europaea* (Common lime), and *Ulmus glabra* (Wych elm).
* **Phenology (September 3):** Fully expanded, dense late-summer crowns with deep dark green foliage; subtle earliest-stage crown-margin chlorosis, localized leaf-tip desiccations, and ripening winged samara clusters; completely intact understory and clipped perimeter turf.
4. OPTICAL DEPTH: Pin-sharp infinite depth of field (f/11). Zero lens blur, tilt-shift, or depth-of-field falloff across foreground and background.

[SOLAR & ATMOSPHERIC LIGHTING OVERRIDE]
SOLAR LIGHT VECTOR (4500K Late afternoon raking sunlight with warm golden highlights): Sun background upper-left (Azimuth 253.3°, Elevation 20.2°). backlit silhouettes with left rim lighting. shadows project forward toward lower-RIGHT.

[SCENE GEOMETRY & AUTHENTIC LITHICS]
Medium format architectural documentary photograph of the Regency neoclassical curved crescent at Ainslie Place, Edinburgh. Symmetrical multi-storey palace-front facade constructed from pale buff-grey Craigleith quartz arenite sandstone, featuring heavy V-jointed ashlar rustication at the principal storey, smooth polished ashlar upper levels, continuous moulded cill bands, projecting dentiled cornice, and ashlar blocking course. Rhythmic vertical grid of multi-pane timber sash-and-case windows set into recessed stone reveals, with six-panel painted timber doors accessible via oversailing ashlar bridge platts. Sunken stone lightwells enclosed by black painted wrought-iron spearhead railings and cast-iron urn finials. Visible historic coal-smoke carbon patination in cornice recesses and subtle mineral rain-wash tracks across ashlar blocks. Curving Caithness flagstone pavement with whinstone kerbstones abutting a macadamised roadway. Across the street curve, the enclosed central park contains mature specimen Acer pseudoplatanus and Tilia × europaea trees displaying dense, mature late-summer green canopies with incipient early September margin yellowing and intact foliage. Pure static survey view: entirely empty streetscape devoid of pedestrians, vehicles, and temporary clutter; crisp planar architectural lines and rectified structural verticals throughout.
